facts.text: Founded in 1842, Villanova is one of two Catholic, Augustinian colleges in the United States; the other is Merrimack College.
All first-year students must take the two-semester Augustine and Culture Seminar sequence.

sources.title: Fulfilling Core Curriculum Course Requirements | Villanova University

facts.text: Students admitted to Villanova as residential students are guaranteed on-campus housing for three consecutive years.
